svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A channel 120 wide, 180 tall and 40 deep, bent from one 3 mm sheet blank.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The web is the flat back the arm bears on; the two flanges point at the pole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank about 120 x 250 mm; the bending shop sets the length for its bend

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: allowance so the web is 180 outside and each flange stands 40 out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Before bending, cut a 120 degree V in each end of the blank (the flange):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 110.9 wide at the free edge, point 32 in from the edge (8 from the web).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Web holes: four 6.6 mm, 35 each side of centre, 25 above and below the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: middle (65 and 115 up from the bottom edge).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Band slots: four 3 x 16 mm, 55 each side of centre, centred 20 from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top and bottom edges. Chain drill 3 mm and file square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend both flanges 90 degrees the same way, inside radius about 3 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr; push rubber edge trim over both V edges (it takes 1.5 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: on a 114 mm tube both V edges touch the tube through the trim.
